notes: No source gives a direction from the unit; the unit's own cistern has position none. S3651 Bir Abu Hindi treated as a row that is itself the water installation, so its reservoir and cistern take the row's periods (Byz, EIs: L); if read as components of a site they would be U. S3763 'central cist (?)' in a cairn coded as a grave (cist, no opening). S3769 'rectangular installation 3.6x4 m' not identified as a pool or pit; S3599 cupmarks not coded. SWP entries ignored as different places with no packet point within 2 km: Tell Abu Hindi (Os, 14.9 km; same-name match, the Jericho tell), Mar Saba (Nu, 4.5 km), Silwan (Mt, 8.9 km), Deir el Kelt (Os, 14.9 km; text cut at 12,000 characters).
